Instructions for Use
Device description: The Aster Spinal System is a spinal fixation system. It is available in lengths from 15 mm to 28 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
The Aster Spinal System is MR Conditional. A person with the Aster Spinal System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Aster Spinal System
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5-Tesla
MR Scanner Type Cylindrical
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 720 Gauss/cm (7.2 T/m)
Maximum Gradient Slew Rate 100 T/m/s per axis
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
B1+rms <= 2 microtesla
Whole-Body SAR ≤ 1 W/kg
